units: <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 5:10">Tosef. Pes. V, 10</cite> <he>ואין תּוֹפְלִין וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>טוֹפְלִין</he>) you must not paste them over with potter’s clay &c. (to take the hair off), v. <cite ref="I00660"><he>טָפַל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 1:14">Sifré Deut. 1</cite> (play on <he>תֹּפֶל</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 1:1">Deut. I, 1</cite>) <he>דברי תפלות שתָּפְלוּ על המן</he> the frivolous words which they cast on the manna; Yalk. ib. 790 <he>שתפלו על המן</he> when they slandered the manna.
